_readme: PRIMARY: MAROON 5 — sale via maroon5jakarta2027.com, drop 29 Aug 2026 10:00 WIB. The tiket.com and S.I.N. targets are off; enable them if the sale moves or you want the fan-club presale watched. All times WIB. The monitor alerts with the real checkout link; warbot.py drives the Tiket.com checkout and stops at an unpaid VA/QRIS.

targets.name: 🔥 MAROON 5 — official sale site
targets._note: PRIMARY. Right now the Artist Presale / BCA Presale / General On-Sale buttons are dead links (href=#). When a window opens they become real tiket.com queue links — that is the change this catches. Server-rendered, so the bot sees the real HTML.

rules._note: THE one that matters: a dead href=# button becoming a real tiket.com/queue URL. Alerts with the actual link, bypasses cooldown, and nags until you /ack. First poll only takes a baseline so existing footer links don't false-fire.
Safety net: catches a redesign or a copy change that the link detector would miss.

targets.name: MAROON 5 — tiket.com backup
targets._note: DISABLED — tiket.com returns 403 to datacenter IPs, and the page is JavaScript-rendered so the bot could never see button text anyway. The official sale site target is the real one. Leave this off.

targets.name: MAROON 5 — S.I.N. fan club signup
targets._note: Artist Presale on 26 Aug needs a code from this fan club. Watches the signup page in case tiers or availability change. Off by default — enable only if you join.

checkout._note: Steps for checkout.py, in QUEUE-FIRST order: get into the waiting room before anything else, hold the slot, and only then type. Nothing is asked of you at run time — profile.json is already on disk, so entry is never waiting on data entry. The map is selector-free on purpose so it works with no advance knowledge of the store's DOM: enter_queue finds the buy control by its wording, and fill_profile matches fields by name/id/placeholder/autocomplete. To pin the exact selectors, run `python3 checkout.py inspect <url>` against the LIVE sale page. Actions: enter_queue, wait_for_queue, click, select, fill, fill_profile, wait_for, goto, screenshot, sleep. Mark early steps "optional": true — the monitor hands over whatever URL it detected, which may already be past them. fill_profile refuses to run while a waiting room is on screen, and the driver halts before anything that looks like paying, whatever these steps say.

_example.note: pinned selector from `inspect`, faster than text matching
explicit admission marker beats the field-count heuristic

steps.note: FIRST ACTION: click into the waiting room. Retries for 90s because the button is often disabled for the first second or two of a sale.
Hold the slot until admitted. Never reloads — a refresh is how you give the place back. 45 min of patience.
name, email, phone, KTP — only ever after admission
